jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Cloud Product Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first (within Germany), but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Cloud Product Manager at Contabo, you're stepping into a role that doesn't come around often: you help build a new product from the ground up – a greenfield venture inside an established company, expanding our portfolio into a new market segment. You are the voice of the market and our customers: you establish feedback channels with customer and support teams, translate market and customer needs into a compelling product vision, and take end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap – from high-level planning through prioritisation to delivery, in close alignment with our PMO.

You work in a small, focused team of experts where speed matters: build fast, test fast, learn fast – with AI tools firmly embedded in our daily work, enabling the pace a venture like this demands. You refine ideas until the development teams can implement them with confidence, sequence roadmap items for maximum impact, and shape the best possible user experience together with your UX tandem partner. You don't shy away from technical discussions – you seek them out: you understand the product architecture across the full stack and keep asking "why" until even hidden blockers are on the table – and resolved quickly.

Because the product is new but the company isn't, you hook into existing processes – in finance and infrastructure, for example – and build new ones where gaps remain. You present progress and updates to stakeholders across development, sales, support, marketing, and leadership, acting as their central point of contact. In the medium term, you establish a product-driven roadmap spanning at least two years, along with KPIs that make the platform's success measurable. The role is built for a high degree of autonomy: you report directly to the Head of Product and work independently, driven by results – with no micromanagement, in either direction.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.
  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.
  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.
  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.
  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.
  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.
  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.
  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.
  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.
  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.
  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.
  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.
  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.
  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.
  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.
  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.
  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.
  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.
  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.
  • You are fluent in both German and English.
  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.
  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.
  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.
  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect — away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more — online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

  1. Application review
  2. Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind
  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our Head of Product & Engineering, Alex.
  4. Raise the bar in a case study and a 60-minute interview with our COO, Ksenia, and CEO, Felix, in our Munich office.

💪 Join us and shape the future of logistics.

Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery

About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

  • Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

  • Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

     

  • Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

     

  • Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

     

  • Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.

     

  • Keep it trustworthy. Treat explainability, control, and guardrails as first-class requirements so customers trust and adopt agentic experiences.

     

  • Grow the mandate. Expand from business tooling into chapter-wide leadership across the full agentic portfolio and the integrations beneath it.

What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have:

  • Shipped a dashboard and tooling experience that gives business teams real transparency into and control over Constructor's agentic experiences, adopted by internal teams and customers.

  • Driven measurable lift in the usage and business impact (conversion, revenue) of agentic experiences across multiple customers.

  • Stood up a repeatable process for launching and experimenting with new agentic interfaces, measurably shortening time-to-launch.

  • Defined the core metrics for agentic discovery and made them visible in one place.

  • Begun uniting the on-site, offsite, and integrations teams behind one coherent direction for the chapter.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in AI/ML, agentic, search, or discovery products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — usage, conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Experience building for business users/operators (merchandisers, category managers, or similar) — especially the tooling, dashboards, and controls they rely on.

  • Strong AI/ML/LLM product depth — understands how agentic and LLM-powered experiences work and can reason about their tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost, reliability).

  • Comfort with zero-to-one ambiguity and with scaling — able to experiment on brand-new interfaces and to build the repeatable process that turns them into a portfolio.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every experience back to usage and business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of success, working shoulder-to-shoulder with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market.

  • A strong instinct for trust — treating transparency, control, and guardrails as core to whether agentic experiences succeed.

  • Comfort setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor At Constructor.io, we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

  • Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.
  • Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.
  • Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.
  • Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.
  • Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.
  • Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.
  • Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

In this role, you'll...

  • Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
  • Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 
  • Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
  • Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.
  • Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
  • Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.
  • Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you:
    • Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org
    • Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation.
  • Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Key Account Executive
jobs.description:
About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine.

Responsibilities

  • Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany.

  • Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth.

  • Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders.

  • Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks.

  • Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities.

  • Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe.

  • Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth.

  • Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary.


    Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment.

  • Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

jobs.description:

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork — fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

Tasks

As the Senior Account Executive, you will make a lasting impact by driving the growth of the company through strategic client acquisition and relationship-building. Your efforts will shape the future of our sales approach, creating a scalable foundation that supports long-term success. As we grow, so can your role, with the opportunity to step into a Head of Sales position and lead the next chapter of our sales organization.

🎖️What Success Looks Like

By 3 months

By 6 months

  • You will build relationships with key decision-makers, and develop a deep understanding of their business needs, processes, and pain points.
  • You will create regular reports on sales performance and pipeline status.
  • You will negotiate contracts and pricing with clients to ensure profitable deals for the company.

Requirements

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field.
  • You bring 5+ years of experience in B2B sales (ideally, SaaS), with a proven track record of success in selling complex and high-value software solutions to clients.
  • You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate the value of our software solution to C-level executives.
  • You possess strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proven track record of securing high-value contracts.
  • You are able to work independently and as part of a team, with a focus on results and a passion for driving revenue growth.
  • You have prior professional experience in startups, consulting firms, or other fast-paced environments.
  • You are able to thoroughly understand and analyze complex client processes, systems & operations, to ensure the proper implementation of our product.
  • You have strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • You are fluent in both German and English.
  • You are based in Munich and able to work from our Munich office at least 3 days per week

⚙️ Must Have Tools and Technologies

  • You are experienced in CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot, and the ability to use data to drive decision-making and optimize the sales process

🌱 How We Set You Up to Be Successful

At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like — we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

  • Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & CEO, Felix, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.
  • Onboarding sessions with our CEO, Felix and COO, Ksenia, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.
  • HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.
  • Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür.
  • A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.
  • Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.
  • We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

Benefits

🌱About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg — and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work — and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us

💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

  3. Deep dive into your experience in a 45-minute interview with our CEO, Felix.
  4. Raise the bar in a case study and 60-minute interview in our Munich office with our CEO, Felix, and COO, Ksenia.

Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt: Agentur des Jahres, dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit.

Was das im Alltag bedeutet:

  • Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
  • 50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
  • Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
  • Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
  • Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.

Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

Zwei Gründe, beide ehrlich:

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.

2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.

Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.

Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.

Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.

Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.

Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP

Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:

PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.

ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.

Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.

Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.

Qualifikation

Du bist unser Mensch, wenn

  • Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
  • Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
  • Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
  • Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
  • Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
  • Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
  • Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.
  • Du auch dann noch weißt, was zu tun ist, wenn der Deadline morgen und das Problem heute ist.

Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite und mit Shopware und/oder Magento.

Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Benefits

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • 70.000 – 85.000 €, abhängig von Erfahrung und Spezialisierung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.
  • Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.
  • Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen (z. B. Shopware, Pimcore, …).
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.
  • Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.
  • MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.
  • Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn – eine Tradition mit Erfolgsgarantie!
  • Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Global VP, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

  • Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions.
  • Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent.
  • Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO.
  • Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
  • Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice.
  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.
  • Systems & Tools: Own the ATS and recruiting tech stack; evaluate and implement tools (sourcing, assessment, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM) to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • DEI: Champion diverse and inclusive hiring practices globally, ensuring equitable processes across all regions.
  • Global & Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with local labor laws and regulations across all operating countries; manage relationships with external agencies, RPOs, and immigration/visa partners as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Own the TA budget, including headcount, tooling, agency spend, and employer branding investments.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and executives on org design, market talent trends, compensation benchmarking, and hiring strategy.

 What we are looking for:

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years in a senior TA leadership role (VP, Head of TA, or similar) at a SaaS or high-growth AI company.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global TA functions across multiple countries/regions (US, Europe)
  • Track record of personally hiring C-Levels
  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Natural ability to convince and motivate C-Level candidates to join our AI strategy.
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable building and presenting TA metrics and forecasts to executive leadership and the board.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of global employment law and compliance considerations related to hiring.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know.

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F (en télétravail depuis Rennes)
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Simon Peraldo - Senior Business Recruiter (30min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Sophie Parachey, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Sophie et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Engineer- Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the end-to-end experience of working with our quantum computers, from the customer-facing web platform for submitting quantum programs and exploring results to the internal interfaces used to run, monitor, and calibrate our machines in the lab. You set the design direction for both, and you build the component library that both are made of. 

This is a design-led role for someone who is not satisfied handing over a Figma file and hoping for the best. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the design direction for our customer-facing cloud platform and our internal operator interface, and keep them coherent as one product family

  • Run the research: interview operators and physicists, observe real calibration workflows in the lab, and turn what you learn into design decisions

  • Produce wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for both surfaces

  • Build and own our design system as production-ready, tested components in code — the shared foundation that our engineers assemble applications from

  • Make dense telemetry and calibration data legible: define the visualisation patterns that let operators see what matters at a glance

  • Validate what ships: run usability tests on implemented interfaces and hold the quality bar between design intent and delivered product

  • Shape APIs together with backend and platform engineers, advocating for the user's perspective early in the process

  • Set the standard for accessibility, usability, and visual consistency, and raise the design literacy of the wider engineering team


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product or interaction design, with a portfolio of shipped digital products

  • Ability to build your own designs as reusable components in production code: confident with TypeScript and React, including component testing and documentation (e.g. Storybook)

  • Mastery of the full design toolkit — research, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, visual design — with Figma as your daily driver

  • Demonstrated experience designing for complex, data-heavy, or expert-user products rather than consumer apps

  • Track record of building or substantially owning a design system

  • Experience planning and running usability testing, and acting on what it tells you

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with domain experts, and to turn ambiguous problems into clear designs

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Real-time data in the browser (WebSockets, streaming telemetry)

  • Experience with scientific, industrial, or laboratory control software

  • Accessibility standards (WCAG) applied in practice

  • Experience mentoring designers or leading design in a cross-functional team

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains.


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Add-Ons

jobs.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.


Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben. 

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.
