jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Vibe

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.


Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.


Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.


This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

  • Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live.

People operations and HR admin

  • Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote.

  • Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring.

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

  • Experience at a scale-up.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.
    This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits.

  2. AI is the buyer.
    Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on.

  3. Financial Services & Regulated business.
    Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated.

We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical.

  • WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market.

  • Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially.

It is a rare role to build category-defining companies learn how they get built, from the inside, at the frontier of AI. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned.

The mission

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two:

80% - real company-building

Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live.

  • Go-to-market, your main focus: you own GTM for each company: positioning, first customers, sales, pricing, go-to-market experiments, and the tools, automations and trackers needed to run them. Hexa’s central pool covers product and design; GTM sits with you. You are part of the company and our growth depend on you.

  • In the operational rhythm of each company: weekly kick-offs, product meetings, end-of-week recaps. You own the cadence, objectives set, notes written, decisions tracked, and leverage AI so we focus our time on building and selling not writing down plans.

  • The founders’ first port of call on anything outside their own scope, and the interface between the ventures and the rest of Hexa (Finance, Legal, Talent, Comms), pulling in the right resource when a project needs it.

20% - studio operations

  • How we run as a studio: keeping the machine sharp and the founder pipeline full.

  • Discovery transforming new ideas into tangible opportunities: discovery outreach and meeting, market sizing, value chain, positioning, the opportunity note that gets a project greenlit.

  • Growing the founder pipeline: working with the Talent team on the sourcing strategy for each new project, gathering top talent in the industry and making WTF visible to the best potential founders and ecosystem players.

  • Building visibility: working with the brand team on Raphaël’s and the studio’s reputation.

  • Improving how the studio (and Hexa) runs: sharpening shared AI agent and tooling (GTM ex: github repo), playbooks and best practice (ex: grokbot rollout), and reusable systems that make the studio & Hexa as a whole compound over time.

Who we’re looking for.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience as founder, go-to-market, growth, operations or even engineering in tech company/ecossystem. This is your shot to build real things, not assist. How you execute and you track executing matters more than the title on your resume.

  • A builder. You’ve been hands-on inside an early-stage startup, or founded something yourself, and you build things: automations, tools, dashboards, experiments.

  • A genuine go-to-market appetite: you’re not afraid to reach out cold, and you like the hands-on part of landing the first customers. You will meet real people and sell while being nobody for them.

  • High agency. You’re the person who figures it out and ships, without waiting to be told how.

  • Hard worker and hungry: you want to be part of building great companies, and you bring energy, hard work and rigor to it.

  • AI nerd: you use AI tools on a daily basis and constantly test switch to better setup.

  • Comfortable being in front of people: reaching out to founders, hosting events, representing the studio.

  • Working in English


Recruitment process

  • First call with Louise (current GTM lead): introduction to Hexa, WTF, check on cultural fit.

  • Interview with Raphaël: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: an exercise inspired by our real work.

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO) and Camille (VP Talent)


What we offer

  • 53-56K + 20% "intéressement": 63K-67K total comp

  • Direct equity in the studio's companies

  • Opportunity to invest in Hexa portfolio startups at a preferential rate

  • Swile meal card

  • 8 to 12 RTT days per year

  • Mobility budget: €500/year for green transportation (bike, metro, electric scooter)

  • Health insurance with 50% coverage for you and your family

  • 1% Holiday bonus

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

jobs.title: Senior User Researcher
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The User Researcher role ⭐️

At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.

As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and collaborate closely with our analytics and data science teams to tell a complete story about our product. You'll also help grow research culture across Alan, sharing your craft and mentoring teammates along the way.

At Alan, great research drives great product. If you love figuring out what people truly need and translating that into decisions that matter, this role is for you.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience as a product/user researcher in a tech environment, with strong hands-on expertise in qualitative methods: interviews, diary studies, think-aloud usability testing, and direct observation

  • Solid quantitative research skills: you're comfortable with survey design, sampling, crosstabs, and core statistical concepts

  • Sharp critical thinking: you quickly identify what research is worth doing, scope it efficiently, and deliver insights that are focused and actionable

  • A strategic mindset: you know how to partner with product stakeholders, communicate the value of research, and tie your findings to concrete business impact

  • Compelling communication skills: you turn complex findings into clear narratives that resonate with any audience

  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or non-researchers, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback that helps others grow

  • You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to leverage and how LLM systems behave in production.

  • You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

  • English fluency, written and spoken

  • (As a plus) Fluency in French, Spanish, or another European language

For this role, we hire within the D-E level range.

🌍 How we work

  • Based in (or within commuting distance of) Paris, with the ability to work onsite twice per week.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

jobs.title: Director of Product Analytics
jobs.description:
About Vibe

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.
Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.
This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You will be Vibe's first dedicated Product Analytics Leader.

Today, Product Managers at Vibe own their analytics end-to-end. While this has worked so far, the increasing complexity of our products, data, and decision-making requires deeper analytical expertise, stronger standards, and more advanced practices.

Your role is to build Product Analytics as a first-class capability across the company: a trusted partner to Product, a driver of better decisions, and a foundation for future scale.

You will work closely with Product Managers, other Analysts, Data Platform, Data Science, and Engineering teams across all domains (DSP, Performance, Supply, Platform).

What You'll Do

You will define, lead, and scale Product Analytics at Vibe. You will be expected to have and communicate a vision for what the function should be doing and its value , ensuring you evolve the Analytics organization for higher relevance and impact.

  • Product Analytics Strategy & Foundations

    • Structure complex and ambiguous problems into projects where data requires disambiguation.

    • Own project delivery from end-to-end, including planning the roadmap and managing resources (people and data).

    • Drive the development of new and insightful analytical approaches and statistical techniques to justify the validity of results.

    • Act as the Product Owner of analytics tools and data assets, overseeing interfaces, schedulers, and reporting systems.

  • Partnering & Influence

    • Lead large meetings with senior management with a focus on key decisions to be taken.

    • Arbitrate conflicts within projects in scope, both inside and outside of the team, ensuring alignment across functions.

    • Manage sensitive situations and relationships in other teams or functions without damage to the relationship or project delivery.

    • Proactively launch and support new projects for the business as a whole, identifying opportunities that go beyond immediate requests.

  • Metrics, Experimentation & Insights

    • Consistently lead and mastermind the hypothesis generation process to drive high-quality, MECE (Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive) hypothesis trees.

    • Guarantee analyses are grounded in reality while effectively anticipating and resolving roadblocks before they occur.

    • Exercise judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria to distinguish correlation from causation in a real-time environment.

  • Team Building & Scale

    • Hire, retain, and motivate strong analysts and managers , creating an atmosphere of enthusiasm, fun, and commitment.

    • Mentor team members on best practices and develop them on all aspects of the Analytical function.

    • Own the knowledge management function in your area of expertise and drive knowledge-sharing initiatives.

    • Provide input on organizational development, skill sets, and training plans.

What You Need

  • Deep understanding of technology, products, and business environments, preferably in AdTech.

  • Proven ability to change the thinking of, or gain acceptance from, others in cross-functional environments.

  • Experience presenting work orally and in writing in a clear, synthetic way with actionable next steps to senior management.

  • Ability to adapt communication to the audience, bridging the gap between technical data and business strategy.

  • Strong statistical foundations, with the ability to drive the development of new statistical techniques for experimentation and causal reasoning.

  • Experience in planning and organizing team missions and evolutions, including resourcing.

  • High proficiency in SQL and data exploration, capable of structuring complex and ambiguous problems.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  1. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  1. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  1. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  1. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  1. (Senior roles only) Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week.

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June  - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna.

Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen.

Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen.

Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln.

Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS. Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt.

  • Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen).

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen.

  • Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services.

  • Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

  • Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen..

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu.

Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button.


Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten.

  • Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten.

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen.

  • Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort



Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Wir suchen nicht den perfekten Lebenslauf, sondern Menschen, die bei Connected Growers glücklich werden. Wenn du nicht alle formalen Kriterien erfüllst, dich aber in der Art, wie wir arbeiten und führen, wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über BridgeMaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
jobs.description:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

    • We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

    • There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

    • We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

jobs.description:

  • Proficiency in Python and core AI/ML libraries, including PyTorch and HuggingFace Transformers, with solid LLMOps/MLOps and CI/CD practices

  • Proven track record of launching AI features end-to-end in production — from problem framing and prototyping through to reliable, measurable delivery

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer, it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

In this role you will:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

  • Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

What you bring:

  1. Strong Technical Foundation:
     A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.

  2. Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

  3. Communication Excellence:
     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  4. Language Proficiency:
     Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)

  5. Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in enterprise automation, business process management (BPM), process orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), Agentic-AI or similar domains.

  • Familiarity with value-based selling, including conducting value workshops and applying value engineering frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of the process automation and orchestration product landscape and key industry players.

  • Industry experience in BFSI, Telecommunications, or Logistics.

jobs.title: Senior SharePoint Migration Lead (EDMS)
jobs.description:
Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and ambitious team and contribute to a strategic enterprise-wide transformation program. As a Senior EDMS Migration Lead, you will play a key role in shaping the future document management landscape.

Key Responsabilities :

  • Lead the Document Management & Migration workstream during the feasibility phase of the program.
  • Define the end-to-end document migration strategy, including migration rules, scope, governance, and decision frameworks.
  • Develop migration roadmaps, pilot approaches, migration waves, and execution plans.
  • Build and validate migration cost models, budgets, and business case recommendations.
  • Coordinate activities across Business Process Owners, Data Analysts, Quality teams, Records Management, IT, Architecture, Procurement, and implementation partners.
  • Define migration principles covering metadata mapping, document cleansing, deduplication, transformation, reconciliation, and validation.
  • Challenge migration methodologies, estimates, and assumptions proposed by vendors and system integrators.
  • Prepare decision-making materials and recommendations for program governance committees.
  • Provide expert guidance on EDMS migrations, records management, information governance, and document lifecycle management.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or equivalent in Information Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related field.
  • Strong professional experience mainly in EDMS and Records Management, Information Governance, or Document Lifecycle Management.
  • Proven leadership of at least two large-scale document migration programs involving multiple repositories.
  • Strong experience building migration strategies, budgets, resource models, pilot plans, and migration roadmaps.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Documentum, OpenText, Veeva QualityDocs, SharePoint, or similar enterprise repositories.
  • Experience within pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical device, or highly regulated industries.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Fluent English.

Benefits

Why join us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.

Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey.

Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission.
